claims.statement: Attention is normalized over input positions to define an instance-dependent output dictionary.
LSTM encoder and decoder score positions with additive attention; selected input coordinates are fed to the next decoding step.
Supervised likelihood training uses one million examples, SGD learning rate 1.0, batch 128, clipping 2.0, and 10-20 epochs.
The 5-50-trained model has 1.3 percent exact accuracy and 99.2 percent area coverage at 500 points.
At 50 points no triangulation is exactly correct, despite 52.8 percent triangle coverage.
The 5-20-trained model has mean length 7.66 at 50 cities, while heuristic A3 has 5.79; no optimum is reported for this size.
Constrained TSP beam search is necessary for larger extrapolation sizes; unconstrained failure reaches 35 and 98 percent at 30 and 40 cities.
The reported reuse is architectural, with task-specific training rather than a demonstrated joint three-task checkpoint.
